payload.text: ST0003/WP02, the login move: a pure planner from the three documents and the request to the ordered writes or a refusal; an executor holding ccusage's switch lock, then Claude Code's refresh and write locks; read-back after each write; and a journal in the state directory, finished by the next run. Built on auth.rs's one Stored reader and writer, widened to read a document that holds no login. Tests on file stores, plus a disposable-keychain test.
